description: Take one rule out of the workspace's cadence rules, for example a rule just kept from a cadence adjustment (its keptRules) that was meant for one campaign only or no longer holds. Takes the rule's text as it was kept. Campaigns already written keep their text; the next ones stop following it. Free.

rule.description: The rule's text, as it is in the rules.

name: remove_cadence_rule
title: Tirar regra de cadência
